front.title: BGP Extension for AI Compute Service Metadata

abstract.t: This document defines four AI inference-specific Sub-TLVs for the BGP Edge Metadata Path Attribute specified in [I-D.ietf-idr-5g-edge-service-metadata]. They advertise model capabilities, aggregated inference latency, optional cost preference, and selected long-lived KV cache prefix identifiers. Authorized CATS Path Selectors (C-PSes) and other policy decision functions may use this information to select suitable service contact instances and forwarding paths. This document reuses the existing optional non- transitive attribute.
